description: Drives dispatch.ts's real retry-then-fallback path end to end. The preferred harness (codex, registered in the eval fixture registry as an always-transport-failing adapter) is attempted twice -- MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_HARNESS -- and both attempts classify as transport rather than logic, so neither is terminal. The router then selects the first fallback whose probe passes (gemini, registered as always-succeeding), the decision is journaled as a task.harness_fallback event, and the task ends succeeded on real verification. Pins two things at once: transport failures are retried and rerouted rather than failing the task, and a rerouted task is still held to the same verification bar as any other.

contract.title: Complete the task after the preferred harness is unreachable

prompt.objective: Update the service manifest, retrying through a fallback harness if the preferred one is unreachable.

acceptance.statement: When the task finishes, the service manifest shall exist in the worktree.
